description: This file defines the LocalizedContentItemIndexProvider class, which implements indexing logic for localized content items in OrchardCore, handling content removal, publication, and indexing of localization parts.

classes.name: LocalizedContentItemIndexProvider
classes.description: Provides indexing for localized content items, managing localization parts and their indexing states.

methods.name: RemovedAsync
methods.description: Handles content removal events, adding content items to the removal set if no active version remains.

methods.name: PublishedAsync
methods.description: Handles content publication events, ensuring localization parts are present and updating content definitions.

methods.name: CollectionName
methods.description: Property for the collection name used in indexing.

methods.name: ForType
methods.description: Returns the type of content item this provider indexes.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Sets up the index description for content items.

methods.name: Describe (overload)
methods.description: Defines how content items are mapped to index records based on localization parts.
